text: It is Sunday morning, and Aziz opens the mobile bank to pay for his gym.
prefix: It is Sunday morning, and Aziz opens the mobile bank to pay for his gym.

text: A yellow line sits at the top of the screen: your passport expires soon, please refresh your identity.
prefix: A yellow line sits at the top of the screen: your passport expires soon, please refresh your identity.

text: His face has not changed, his phone has not changed, and his password has not changed.
prefix: His face has not changed, his phone has not changed, and his password has not changed.

text: So why does the bank care about a date in a small book in his drawer?
prefix: So why does the bank care about a date in a small book in his drawer?

text: In Lesson 15, MyID proved Aziz with a full proofing, and in Lesson 17 the platform kept the result as a verified identity, in versions.
prefix: In Lesson 15, MyID proved Aziz with a full proofing, and in Lesson 17 the platform kept the result as a verified identity, in versions.

text: This lesson adds time: a document ends, and the record must follow it, without one field changing behind Aziz's back.
prefix: This lesson adds time: a document ends, and the record must follow it, without one field changing behind Aziz's back.

text: Start with the date.
prefix: Start with the date.

text: The verified identity keeps the expiry date of the document.
prefix: The verified identity keeps the expiry date of the document.

text: From that date, the platform calculates a document status: valid, expiring or expired.
prefix: From that date, the platform calculates a document status: valid, expiring or expired.

text: Expiring starts the configured lead time before the date, and expired starts after the date.
prefix: Expiring starts the configured lead time before the date, and expired starts after the date.

text: A job in the workers calculates the status again one time each day, and again at each refresh.
prefix: A job in the workers calculates the status again one time each day, and again at each refresh.

text: When the status becomes expiring, the platform writes one audit event: document expiring.
prefix: When the status becomes expiring, the platform writes one audit event: document expiring.

text: From then on, the bank's app asks Aziz to do a refresh at each start.
prefix: From then on, the bank's app asks Aziz to do a refresh at each start.

text: That is the yellow line he sees on Sunday.
prefix: That is the yellow line he sees on Sunday.

text: Aziz is busy, so he taps later, and the date passes.
prefix: Aziz is busy, so he taps later, and the date passes.

text: Now the status is expired.
prefix: Now the status is expired.

text: What happens next is the part I like most, because of what does not happen.
prefix: What happens next is the part I like most, because of what does not happen.

text: The access grant stays valid.
prefix: The access grant stays valid.

text: The platform does not block Aziz, and it does not ask for MyID at login.
prefix: The platform does not block Aziz, and it does not ask for MyID at login.

text: Instead, the identity summary that the app reads gets a restricted flag, and a list of allowed actions that the bank configures.
prefix: Instead, the identity summary that the app reads gets a restricted flag, and a list of allowed actions that the bank configures.

text: Aziz gets the security notification document expired, by SMS to his verified number and by push to his devices.
prefix: Aziz gets the security notification document expired, by SMS to his verified number and by push to his devices.

text: The trail gets the audit event document expired.
prefix: The trail gets the audit event document expired.

text: In this first version, the app of the bank applies the restriction from the flag, and a later phase moves that rule into the platform.
prefix: In this first version, the app of the bank applies the restriction from the flag, and a later phase moves that rule into the platform.

text: Only one thing removes the flag: a successful refresh.
prefix: Only one thing removes the flag: a successful refresh.

text: So what is a refresh?
prefix: So what is a refresh?

text: It is not a form where someone types the new passport number.
prefix: It is not a form where someone types the new passport number.

text: It is a new full proofing, with the purpose refresh.
prefix: It is a new full proofing, with the purpose refresh.

text: A refresh can start in three ways.
prefix: A refresh can start in three ways.

text: Aziz can start it himself, for example on the day he gets his new passport.
prefix: Aziz can start it himself, for example on the day he gets his new passport.

text: The app starts it while the status is expiring or expired.
prefix: The app starts it while the status is expiring or expired.

text: And an operator can ask for it, with a reason, and the app shows that request at the next start.
prefix: And an operator can ask for it, with a reason, and the app shows that request at the next start.

text: Before it begins, a refresh needs a trusted device and a valid access grant.
prefix: Before it begins, a refresh needs a trusted device and a valid access grant.

text: Then it takes the road from module four.
prefix: Then it takes the road from module four.

text: The consent gate shows its text, and Aziz accepts it.
prefix: The consent gate shows its text, and Aziz accepts it.

text: The platform opens a MyID session with his personal identification number already set, so the master app goes straight to the face.
prefix: The platform opens a MyID session with his personal identification number already set, so the master app goes straight to the face.

text: Aziz looks into the camera, and MyID compares his face with the state records.
prefix: Aziz looks into the camera, and MyID compares his face with the state records.

text: The result comes back, and Aziz confirms the data on his screen.
prefix: The result comes back, and Aziz confirms the data on his screen.

text: One step is missing on purpose: a refresh does not do the phone check.
prefix: One step is missing on purpose: a refresh does not do the phone check.

text: Now the result.
prefix: Now the result.

text: The personal identification number is the same, so the platform writes a new version of the verified identity and makes it current.
prefix: The personal identification number is the same, so the platform writes a new version of the verified identity and makes it current.

text: It keeps the earlier version.
prefix: It keeps the earlier version.

text: The reusable identifier and its expiry date are new too, so later re-checks can use them.
prefix: The reusable identifier and its expiry date are new too, so later re-checks can use them.

text: The document status is calculated again: valid, and the restricted flag goes away.
prefix: The document status is calculated again: valid, and the restricted flag goes away.

text: Aziz gets the security notification identity refreshed, and the trail gets the audit event identity refreshed.
prefix: Aziz gets the security notification identity refreshed, and the trail gets the audit event identity refreshed.

text: Here is the rule under all of this, and I think it is the most important sentence of the lesson.
prefix: Here is the rule under all of this, and I think it is the most important sentence of the lesson.

text: No field of the verified identity changes without a live face check that the customer completed, in a session that the platform opened.
prefix: No field of the verified identity changes without a live face check that the customer completed, in a session that the platform opened.

text: Not a support ticket, not an import from another system, not an operator with good intentions.
prefix: Not a support ticket, not an import from another system, not an operator with good intentions.

text: An operator can ask for a refresh, but an operator cannot type a new surname.
prefix: An operator can ask for a refresh, but an operator cannot type a new surname.

text: A refresh also obeys the attempt limits of Lesson 11, for the personal identification number and the device.
prefix: A refresh also obeys the attempt limits of Lesson 11, for the personal identification number and the device.

text: Only a refresh that an operator asks for is not counted.
prefix: Only a refresh that an operator asks for is not counted.

text: To recap: the expiry date gives a status, and the status gives a reaction.
prefix: To recap: the expiry date gives a status, and the status gives a reaction.

text: Expiring asks, expired restricts, and neither one blocks.
prefix: Expiring asks, expired restricts, and neither one blocks.

text: Only a new live face check changes the record, as a new version next to the old one.
prefix: Only a new live face check changes the record, as a new version next to the old one.

text: But there is one case where a refresh does end in a block: when the result carries a different personal identification number.
prefix: But there is one case where a refresh does end in a block: when the result carries a different personal identification number.

text: So what does a block really do, and who is allowed to lift it?
prefix: So what does a block really do, and who is allowed to lift it?
